name: Kinomiya Nanoka
source:
Her desk in class is next to yours.
Bright, positive, and inexhaustibly smiley, she's popular.
But passionate, too—she has a dream that pushes her to cram school after class.
"It's fun to whisper in class like this, isn't it?"

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/sutadhisutedhi-en-zh/]Johren.games[/url]]

Hobby: Animal Care
Favorite Food: Taiyaki
Relationship Goals: Let's make out while holding hands.

[spoiler]She makes an appearance in Study Steady 2 in [url=https://vndb.org/c100709]Urumi's[/url] route as Reido's lover.
She also makes a brief appearance in [url=https://vndb.org/c100706]Yuno[/url]'s route.[/spoiler]
